positions.name: AtlasRollbackRehearsalCadence
positions.frame: How is the cadence of rollback rehearsal set and owned, and what makes a rollback count as one the organization actually has?
positions.why: Quinton's directive (src-1) sets monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals as a standing practice and argues that an unrehearsed rollback is not a real one. The memo (src-2, src-3) records the same cadence and assigns ownership to Quinton Fairweather as settled operational fact. The three expressions share one read: the rehearsal cadence and its ownership are decided from rank, and the cadence is tied to whether rollback capability exists. The sources differ in kind. src-1 is a spoken directive with conviction, while src-2 and src-3 are declarative memo fields whose footing is the memo author, so the tension between a personal directive and a recorded allocation is held, not resolved.
